issues.description: Pvalb and RORa are shared with molecular layer interneurons and are NOT Purkinje-specific; several quotes explicitly note Parv/RORa label both PCs and MLIs. Calb1 (calbindin) is the specific PC marker and is absent in basket cells (41293753_2d217397).

gaps: negative_markers — none proposed; colocated_types partially supported (basket/stellate target PC soma/dendrites, recurrent PC-PC collaterals in Witter 2016 / 2715384_aae5251c)

issues.description: HCN1, Kv1.1, PSD95 and GAD67 are reported as markers of basket-cell PINCEAUX (subcellular structures) that map onto Purkinje zones (Zhou et al. 2020), not as whole-cell defining markers. Pvalb/RORa are pan-MLI + PC markers, not basket-specific. No basket-specific transcriptomic marker exists (see HETEROGENEITY below).

Ephys claims for stellate cells are drawn from studies contrasting stellate vs basket contributions to PC simple/complex spikes (Brown 2018); many recordings label cells only as 'MLIs' without resolving stellate vs basket identity.

No stellate-specific positive marker exists. Pvalb, RORa, Grid1 are shared across all MLIs. Wang 2020 explicitly notes a lack of molecular markers to distinguish basket from stellate cells (213840122_322ac0e3).

gaps: stellate-specific marker — none exists (see basket/stellate continuum)

issues.description: Candelabrum cells are described as 'molecularly distinct' by snRNAseq but the ingested quotes name no specific positive marker gene. Sarropoulos 2023 (237308705_5cd4bd6a) names Purkinje-layer interneurons as Nxph1/Klhl1 but does not resolve candelabrum-specific markers.

gaps: defining_markers — no specific positive marker gene in quotes

issues.description: Marker-to-class assignment is not fully consistent across quotes. Lowenstein 2022 assigns Sorcs3+ to class I (MLI1) and Nxph1+ to class II (MLI2). Sarropoulos 2023 assigns Sorcs3/Grm8 to 'type 1' and Nxph1/Pvalb to MLI2, but ALSO lists Nxph1/Klhl1 as Purkinje-layer interneuron markers — so Nxph1 is not unique to MLI2. Class-specific markers should be verified against primary transcriptomic data.

This node bundles two distinct transcriptomic types (MLI1/class I and MLI2/class II) with different markers, connectivity, and ephys. It is a candidate for splitting into two separate nodes and a CL new-term request (BROAD cl_mapping flag).

gaps: No CL term for the MLI1/MLI2 split (BROAD mapping only)

cross_node_issues.description: The classical basket/stellate morphological categories (basket_cell_cerebellum, stellate_cell_cerebellum) map only imperfectly onto the transcriptomic MLI1/MLI2 classes (mli_transcriptomic_classes_cerebellum). Multiple sources state the basket/stellate distinction is a morphological continuum without clean molecular boundaries, while the two transcriptomic classes cut across that continuum. The relationship between these two node sets needs mapping edges backed by primary literature (deferred; edges left empty).

Pvalb (parvalbumin) is expressed by Purkinje cells AND all molecular-layer interneurons, so it cannot discriminate PC from basket from stellate. It is retained as a defining marker only in combination with layer/morphology, not as a discriminating marker.
